nodes.label: Simple UX guidelines
nodes.rationale: Navigation should be intuitive, clear, and focused on core user journeys with progressive disclosure.

nodes.label: Responsive design requirements
nodes.rationale: Interfaces should work across desktop, tablet, and mobile, with accessible touch targets.

nodes.label: Feature-based code organization
nodes.rationale: Page-specific UI is co-located with pages while shared UI and resource data have designated locations.

nodes.label: Check before deploy
nodes.rationale: Deployment waits on type-check/build because a prior broken image build could stop the live front end.

nodes.label: Persian-first bilingual RTL layout
nodes.rationale: Persian is the priority, English remains maintained; RTL layout is a correctness requirement.

nodes.label: Route-scoped en/fa translation parity
nodes.rationale: User-facing copy goes through route-scoped namespaces in both catalogues, with matching keys.

nodes.label: Empty console front door
nodes.rationale: Console landing returned an empty div, providing no orientation, recent reports, or jump to national ID.

nodes.label: EHR today-to-today default
nodes.rationale: Default date range often returns no rows, making the flagship table appear broken on first visit.

nodes.label: Periodical report null date range
nodes.rationale: The report needs a form fill before anything appears.

nodes.label: Abnormal-first patient record
nodes.rationale: Physicians need to identify abnormal findings; flat status grids bury them among normal results.

nodes.label: Logical CSS and document direction
nodes.rationale: Physical CSS properties and missing html dir/lang broke the Persian experience.

nodes.label: Write operation error feedback
nodes.rationale: Upload and delete are the only two write operations and failures were silent.

nodes.label: Patient Portal
nodes.rationale: Patients see their own EHR records without a Django account or staff console.

nodes.label: Patient sign-in route
nodes.rationale: National ID is used as both username and password, with a nonempty EHR result admitting the session.

nodes.label: Patient records route
nodes.rationale: Records are scoped to session national ID; UI offers date range and patient type filters only.

nodes.label: Patient session
nodes.rationale: Session storage holds the national ID; three states avoid a sign-in flash during hydration.

nodes.label: Patient UX gate
nodes.rationale: Explicitly accepted as a UX gate, not a security boundary, because the upstream EHR endpoint is unauthenticated.

nodes.label: Lean patient records provider
nodes.rationale: Separate from console provider because national ID must be session-bound and console actions cannot be opened by patients.

nodes.label: Shared EHR detail dialog
nodes.rationale: Patient route reuses the EHR detail modal while omitting phone-number lookup; lab and x-ray downloads remain.

nodes.label: Uploaded Excel monitoring datasets
nodes.rationale: Each occupational health workbook has one row per person.

nodes.label: Step 1 report route
nodes.rationale: Step 1 has its own 96-field record shape and route.

nodes.label: Step 2 report route
nodes.rationale: Step 2 has its own 155-field record shape and config-driven charts.

nodes.label: Managed monitoring types
nodes.rationale: Backend types are open-ended; staff can create types without dashboard report routes.

nodes.label: Dashboard-supported monitoring types
nodes.rationale: SBHM_Type describes only the types this dashboard can render; unknown types require a guard.

nodes.label: Exact Excel payload field names
nodes.rationale: Unicode and duplicate-header suffixes must match payload byte for byte or charts silently render empty.

nodes.label: Config-driven Step 2 charts
nodes.rationale: One chart config drives type-safe fields, computation, translated labels, and rendering.

nodes.label: Sortable RTL data table
nodes.rationale: Generic table supports sorting and RTL; parent owns loading and error states.

nodes.label: Generic table column hook
nodes.rationale: Configurable columns, locale-aware formatting, custom cells, optional actions.

nodes.label: EHR table column hook
nodes.rationale: Predefined EHR fields including name, national ID, date, service, doctor, place, patient type, actions.

nodes.label: Neutral spine and sparse brand color
nodes.rationale: Near-grey chrome leaves colour for meaningful data and a sparse primary action hue.
nodes.norm_label: neutral spine and sparse brand color

nodes.label: Semantic status colors
nodes.rationale: Success, warning, destructive, and info encode states that prior single destructive color could not distinguish.

nodes.label: Three chart color scales
nodes.rationale: Categorical, sequential, and diverging scales correspond to distinct data shapes.

nodes.label: Contrast validation
nodes.rationale: Both themes and token pairs have programmatic WCAG ratio gates.
